facts.text: American Baptist College is a historically Black Christian college in Nashville whose notable civil rights alumni include Congressman John Lewis and the Reverend C.T. Vivian.

sources.title: From the President: John Lewis, A Warrior For Justice - American Baptist College
sources.quote: Coming to Nashville at a young age as a student at American Baptist College, John Lewis was captured by the dream of a world of fairness and equality, ideals of the beloved community.
